```{r}
# Read the TSV file
meta <- read.table("../data/01_meta_untidy.tsv",
                   sep = "\t",
                   header = TRUE)

library(reactable)

reactable(meta,
          sortable = TRUE,
          resizable = TRUE,
          height = "500px",
          theme = reactableTheme(
            style = list(fontSize = "20px")  # shrink text; default is 16px
          )
)

```
